review_candidates.description: System Engineer - Client Budget - $55k-60k Location - Hampton, Virginia, United States (On-site) We are seeking a highly skilled Level 3 (L3) System Engineer with strong expertise across Wintel and Network technologies. The ideal candidate will act as the final escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents, own root cause analysis (RCA), and provide technical leadership across Microsoft and network environments. Roles & Responsibilities: Act as the L3 escalation point for infrastructure incidents and service requests. Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint. Manage Azure Entra ID (Azure AD), hybrid identity, SSO, MFA, and Conditional Access. Administer Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Server environments. Manage and troubleshoot Hyper-V virtualization platforms. Perform server patching, upgrades, security hardening, and vulnerability remediation. Design, implement, and support LAN/WAN infrastructure. Manage switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, and wireless controller environments. Support firewall technologies such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, and Cisco FTD. Perform RCA for recurring incidents and infrastructure outages. Create SOPs, architecture documentation, and operational procedures. Mentor L1/L2 engineers and provide technical leadership Coordinate with stakeholders, consultants, and technical teams for successful project delivery. Required Skills: Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 administration. Expertise in Azure Entra ID (Azure AD), MFA, Conditional Access, and hybrid identity. Strong Active Directory administration and troubleshooting skills. Experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022. Strong Hyper-V administration and troubleshooting experience. Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, and Qos. Hands-on experience with enterprise switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, and wireless environments. Strong troubleshooting, incident management, and RCA capabilities. Qualifications: Experience in infrastructure support and operations. Strong experience handling L3 escalations and critical incidents. Experience in enterprise or MSP environments. Strong communication and documentation skills.

review_candidates.title: L3 Network Security Engineer – Cisco ASA / Fortinet / CCNP Location: Electronic City, Bangalore
review_candidates.description: L3 Network Security Engineer – Cisco ASA / Fortinet / CCNP Location: Electronic City, Bangalore Work Mode: Work From Office – 5 Days a Week Experience: 10–15 Years Employment Type: Full-Time Candidate Location: Bangalore candidates preferred Interview Requirement: First round will be Face-to-Face (F2F) at Electronic City, Bangalore Position Overview We are looking for an experienced L3 Network Security Engineer with 10–15 years of strong hands-on experience in enterprise network security, firewall administration and Routing & Switching. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Cisco ASA and Fortinet/FortiGate firewalls, along with advanced knowledge of Cisco Routers, Switches, LAN/WAN, VPN, NAT, ACL, OSPF, BGP, STP, HSRP and VRRP. The candidate will be responsible for L3 troubleshooting, network security implementation, firewall configuration, migration, upgrades, incident resolution and customer-facing technical support across enterprise environments. Key Responsibilities • Act as an L3 escalation engineer for complex network security and enterprise networking issues. • Design, configure, implement and troubleshoot Cisco ASA and Fortinet/FortiGate firewalls. • Configure and manage firewall policies, ACLs, NAT, VPN, IPSec/SSL VPN and security rules. • Manage firewall High Availability (HA) configurations and troubleshoot failover-related issues. • Design, implement and support enterprise LAN/WAN network infrastructure. • Configure and troubleshoot Cisco Routers and Switches. • Handle advanced Routing & Switching issues involving OSPF, BGP, STP, HSRP and VRRP. • Perform advanced troubleshooting of network connectivity, routing, firewall and security incidents. • Analyze packet captures, logs and network traffic to identify and resolve complex issues. • Perform firewall and network device firmware upgrades, patching, configuration backup and restoration. • Support network migrations, technology upgrades and infrastructure implementation projects. • Provide L3 support during critical incidents and planned maintenance windows. • Work with customers and internal/global teams to understand requirements and provide technical solutions. • Coordinate with OEM/vendor support teams for complex hardware, software and security issues. • Prepare HLD/LLD documents, implementation plans, network diagrams, SOPs and troubleshooting documents. • Participate in Change Management, Incident Management and Problem Management processes. • Mentor L1/L2 network engineers and provide technical guidance on complex issues. • Ensure adherence to network security standards, operational procedures and customer SLAs. Mandatory Technical Skills Network Security / Firewalls • 10+ years of Network Security / Network Engineering experience • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco ASA Firewall • Strong hands-on experience with Fortinet / FortiGate Firewall • Firewall policy configuration and troubleshooting • ACL, NAT and security policies • IPSec VPN / SSL VPN • Firewall High Availability / Failover • Firewall migration and upgrade experience • Strong troubleshooting of complex firewall and connectivity issues Routing & Switching Strong hands-on experience with: • Cisco Routers • Cisco Switches • OSPF • BGP • VLAN • STP • HSRP • VRRP • LAN/WAN technologies • TCP/IP • Inter-VLAN routing • Routing protocols and troubleshooting L3 Troubleshooting • Advanced network troubleshooting and root-cause analysis • Packet capture and traffic analysis • Network connectivity troubleshooting • Routing and firewall path analysis • Log analysis • Incident and problem management • Ability to independently resolve complex L3 network issues Good to Have • CCNP certification – Preferred, not mandatory • Cisco Nexus Switches • Cisco ACI • FortiManager • FortiAnalyzer • Cisco Firepower / FTD • Palo Alto Firewall • SD-WAN • Cloud Networking – AWS / Azure • ITIL / ITSM process knowledge • Network monitoring tools • Network automation knowledge Leadership & Customer-Facing Responsibilities Since this is an L3 Engineer position, the candidate should be capable of: • Independently handling complex technical escalations. • Taking ownership of critical incidents from troubleshooting through resolution. • Interacting directly with customers and technical stakeholders. • Leading network implementation and migration activities. • Providing technical guidance to L1/L2 engineers. • Conducting knowledge-sharing and technical mentoring sessions. • Preparing RCA and preventive-action reports. • Working with global teams across different time zones. • Taking ownership of technical deliverables and project timelines. Candidate Profile • 10–15 years of relevant experience in Network Engineering / Network Security. • Strong hands-on expertise in Cisco ASA + Fortinet/FortiGate is mandatory. • Strong enterprise Routing & Switching experience. • Strong L3 troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities. • Good communication and customer-facing skills. • Experience working in enterprise/global network environments. • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related discipline preferred. • Candidates must be available for a Face-to-Face first-round interview at Electronic City, Bangalore. Important Hiring Criteria We are specifically looking for senior hands-on L3 engineers, not purely monitoring or L1/L2 support profiles. Candidates should have demonstrated experience in: Cisco ASA + FortiGate + Cisco Routing & Switching + L3 Troubleshooting + VPN + NAT + ACL + OSPF/BGP + Enterprise LAN/WAN

review_candidates.title: AVP/VP, Network Engineer, Technology Group
review_candidates.job_function: Project Management, Analyst, and Information Technology
review_candidates.description: GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide. Technology Group We experiment, design, and lead a 24×7 global business where we support core capabilities in asset management, trading, investment operations, and risk management. We deliver secure, reliable, and integrated solutions, and provide insights on new, and emerging technologies. Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Resilience (ICR) We design, build, and secure the technology foundations that power GIC’s global investment operations. We aim to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure infrastructure that empowers our people and businesses to perform securely, efficiently, and effectively. What impact can you make in this role? The AVP/VP, Network Engineer is responsible for the design, engineering, and delivery of network infrastructure across all GIC data centres and office sites globally. This hands-on technical role owns the architecture and build of Data Centre, Campus, and WAN/SD-WAN networks across a multi-vendor estate, and applies network automation to improve consistency, scalability, and delivery velocity. The role partners closely with Network Operations, Security, and other infrastructure engineering teams to translate business and technical requirements into resilient, secure, and standardised network solutions. This is an individual-contributor technical role. In addition to deep hands-on engineering across Data Centre Networks, Campus Networks (wired and wireless), and SD-WAN, the role engages vendors and product principals to drive feature enhancements and influence product roadmaps, and requires the ability to develop, read and make edits to automation code (Ansible), backed by sound knowledge of financial-sector security and compliance requirements. What will you do as an AVP/VP, Network Automation and Reliability Engineer? Network Engineering & Solution Design Leadership Lead the design and engineering of network solutions across Data Centre, Campus, and WAN/SD-WAN domains, ensuring scalability, resilience, security, and performance. Produce high-quality low-level and high-level designs (HLDs/LLDs), standards, and reference architectures aligned to financial-industry best practices. Act as the technical authority and design-approval reviewer for network changes and new builds, ensuring engineering rigour and adherence to architectural standards. Partner with Network Operations, Security, and other infrastructure engineering teams to translate requirements into deployable, well-documented solutions. Core Engineering Responsibilities Data Centre Networks Design, build, and evolve data centre fabrics using EVPN/VXLAN, Cisco ACI, and modern spine-leaf architectures across a multi-vendor estate (e.g., Cisco, Arista, Juniper). Engineer multi-tenancy, segmentation, and high-availability designs, including integration with load balancers (e.g., F5 LTM/GTM) and L4–L7 services. Define oversubscription, capacity, and failure-domain strategies to support trading and critical workloads. Campus Networks Engineer enterprise campus LAN and wireless solutions (routing, switching, Wi-Fi 6/7 with a managed controller ecosystem) using standardised, templated designs across sites of varying size. Implement access security and segmentation (802.1X, NAC, zoning) in collaboration with Security teams. Ensure resilient, performant designs for corporate connectivity. SD-WAN, WAN & Secure Connectivity Design and deliver SD-WAN and WAN solutions, including overlay transport, application-aware routing, secure connectivity, and cloud on-ramp, using leading platforms (e.g., Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN/Viptela, Fortinet, Versa, VMware VeloCloud, or equivalent). Embed Zero Trust and SASE principles into WAN and remote-access designs (e.g., Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, Prisma Access, or equivalent). Lead WAN modernisation and migration efforts (e.g., MPLS to SD-WAN) with structured, low-risk transition plans. Engineer secure interconnectivity between data centres, campus sites, and cloud providers. Network Automation (Ansible) Develop new, read, interpret, and make edits to existing Ansible playbooks, roles, and Jinja2 templates to support network provisioning, configuration management, and compliance. Maintain and extend standardised configuration templates, and use automated validation within delivery workflows. Apply automation to drive configuration consistency, support drift detection, and reduce manual TOIL across the network estate. (Preferred) Familiarity with adjacent automation/IaC tooling — Python scripting, Terraform, YAML, and CI/CD pipelines (Git-based) — to support scalable, repeatable delivery. Security & Resilience Integration Embed security baselines, hardening standards, and segmentation into all network designs. Engineer for high availability, redundancy, and compliance with internal RTO/RPO and resilience targets. Project Delivery & Lifecycle Management Lead engineering delivery for network projects from design through build, testing, and handover to operations. Develop detailed test plans, simulation/validation approaches, implementation steps, and rollback strategies for high-risk changes. Maintain comprehensive design documentation, build guides, and as-built records to meet operational and audit expectations. Observability, Performance & Troubleshooting Design and apply network observability — telemetry, monitoring, flow analytics, and dashboards — to provide visibility across DC, campus, and WAN. Provide advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex, cross-domain network issues, including performance optimisation. Establish baselines and proactive alerting to detect and pre-empt performance degradation. Vendor & Product Engagement Engage vendors and product principals to evaluate technologies and influence feature enhancements and product roadmaps aligned to the firm’s network strategy. Provide structured technical feedback, raise and track enhancement and defect requests, and validate fixes and new features through proofs-of-concept and testing. Maintain strong working relationships with OEMs and partners to support technical escalations, product lifecycle planning, and assessment of emerging technologies. Collaboration & Standards Work closely with the Network Operations team to ensure solutions are operable, monitored, and supportable, and to incorporate operational feedback into designs. Define and maintain engineering standards, design templates, and gold-standard configuration baselines. Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex network issues and share engineering knowledge across teams. Governance, Risk & Compliance Ensure all network designs and changes adhere to internal controls, security baselines, and regulatory frameworks (MAS-TRM, CSA CCoP, and NIST CISF guidelines). Support internal/external audits with design documentation, technical evidence, and explanations of network controls and configurations. What qualifications or skills should you possess in this role? Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience. Experience: 8–12 years of experience in Network Engineering, with at least 3–5 years in a senior design/engineering capacity—preferably in the financial industry. (AVP candidates: 6–10 years with demonstrated hands-on engineering depth.) Technical Expertise: Data Centre Networks (EVPN/VXLAN, Cisco ACI, spine-leaf, F5 LTM/GTM) across a multi-vendor estate (Cisco, Arista, Juniper) Enterprise Campus Networks (routing, switching, Wi-Fi 6/7 and wireless controller ecosystems) SD-WAN design and delivery on leading platforms (e.g., Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN/Viptela, Fortinet, Versa, VMware VeloCloud) and WAN technologies Zero Trust / SASE and network security (segmentation, NAC, IDS/IPS, firewalls; e.g., Zscaler or Prisma Access or Netskope) Working ability to create, read and edit network automation code, primarily Ansible (playbooks, roles, Jinja2 templates), with version control (Git) (Preferred) Adjacent automation/IaC — Python, Terraform, YAML, CI/CD pipelines Strong knowledge of networking protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IPsec, DNS, DHCP, QoS) Network observability and monitoring tooling (telemetry, flow analytics, dashboards) Cloud Networking (AWS, GCP, Azure) Certifications (preferred): Professional certifications such as CCNP/CCIE (Enterprise or Data Center); relevant security or SD-WAN vendor certifications Familiarity with ITIL, NIST CSF, and financial-sector risk frameworks Comfortable reading and modifying automation scripts (Ansible, Python) to improve consistency and reduce operational risk Soft Skills Strong technical depth with the ability to lead complex network design and delivery end-to-end as an individual contributor. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause-analysis skills, with clear communication for both technical and executive audiences. Ability to engage and influence vendors and product principals to shape enhancements and roadmaps. Collaborative mindset with the ability to influence across architecture, operations, and compliance teams. Work at the Point of Impact We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact. GIC is a Great Place to Work At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise. GIC is an equal opportunity employer As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. review_candidates.description: Retail Infrastructure Specialist - Information & Technology Dolce & Gabbana represents excellence rooted in its “Made in Italy” heritage. Every creation reflects the Brand’s commitment to craftsmanship, fatto a mano, innovation and quality. Guided by a strong dedication to sustainability, the Brand adopts certified materials and responsible practices, ensuring that contemporary luxury is created with respect for future generations. ROLE Dolce & Gabbana, a leader in the world of luxury fashion, has an exceptional career opportunity available for a Permanent Retail Infrastructure Specialist. The Retail Infrastructure Specialist is responsible for the stability, performance and continuous improvement of the technology supporting Dolce & Gabbana in the United States and Canada, with a particular focus on store-side technology, the connectivity and end-user infrastructure that enables them. The role pairs hands-on technical ownership with proactive coordination across the regional IT team, contributing to a seamless customer and employee experience. MISSION Act proactively and transparently to ensure the optimal functioning of network, connectivity and end-user infrastructure at retail locations and corporate, including switches, firewalls, wireless access points and residual on-premise servers. Oversee the lifecycle of Retail Store Technology, ensuring stability, functionality and efficiency across all locations. Prevent and troubleshoot infrastructure- and application-related issues; escalate when appropriate and maintain full ownership until resolution. Manage backups, business continuity routines and disaster recovery procedures within scope, aligning with global standards as the cloud transition progresses. Coordinate and assist the provisioning and installation of new equipment during upgrade cycles, new store openings and other business expansions, in close coordination with the regional and global teams. Coordinate external vendors as needed. Collaborate and coordinate closely with the IT Project & Support Specialist and the PC & Telecommunications Specialist on shared activities such as store openings, hardware rollouts and end-user support. Collaborate with corporate, retail and project stakeholders to anticipate support needs, improve user experience and identify opportunities to streamline retail technology. Maintain and update documentation, asset records and other shared materials to ensure accuracy and usability across the team. TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES Strong knowledge of retail store technology, POS systems and store-side connectivity. Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, firewalls) and enterprise end-user computing. Working knowledge of cloud and SaaS-based services and their integration with retail operations. Windows Server administration skills to support residual on-premise systems at the stores and corporate. Cybersecurity fundamentals applied to retail and end-user environments. Know-how to formalize and draw up documentation relating to projects, processes and infrastructure changes. BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES Proactivity Sense of ownership Communication and collaboration Organizational commitment Internal client orientation Key Performance Indicators Uptime and performance of retail systems, networks and POS platforms achieved through proactive monitoring and preventive measures. Average issue resolution time and first-attempt resolution rate across infrastructure and application requests. Completeness and accuracy of new installations and POS configurations by go-live deadlines. Quality of coordination across the regional IT team, measured by smooth execution of joint initiatives. Overall user satisfaction with retail technology and end-user support. PROFILE 3+ years of experience in a comparable role, with a meaningful component in retail IT or POS support, preferably within luxury fashion or premium retail environments. Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical work with cross-functional coordination across peers and external vendors. Working knowledge of network infrastructure, end-user computing and at least one cloud platform (e.g., Microsoft 365, Azure). Familiarity with SD-WAN deployments and modern retail connectivity standards. Cybersecurity awareness applied to day-to-day operations; Microsoft and/or Cisco certifications are a plus. Excellent teamwork and communication skills, with a client-oriented mindset and ability to listen effectively. review_candidates.title: Principal Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. What You’ll Be Doing... The Verizon Network Security team is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Principal Engineer to join the Net-Sec Defense Organization under the Broadband Access team. You will be responsible for owning the Network security posture, Security Lifecycle and protection against threats across the Broadband access network that includes, but is not limited to Edge Routers, Broadband Access routers and switches, CPE equipment and RAN transport infrastructure. The candidate will be required to understand complex network architectures utilizing various protocols, topologies, and vendor hardware . This role involves hands-on work and demonstrating subject matter expertise with Routers, switches, and other networking gear, as well as Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools, particularly Splunk and ISE. The engineer would be required to leverage automation platforms to develop scripts and tools to enhance security operations and play a key role in monitoring, analyzing, and leading response to network security incidents while implementing proactive measures to safeguard critical assets. You will be responsible for continuously monitoring and proactively detecting threats to safeguard network functions and assets, with a focus on leveraging automation and AI. This includes accountability for the network security scorecard for each network element type. Additionally, you will collaborate with internal organizations and vendors to improve security posture by implementing Network Security Policies across diverse network elements. Planning, designing, and leading execution of Network Security policies across all owned assets. Utilize existing expertise of routing, switching and network architecture to build a deep understanding of the network assets under your span of control and the product and feature roadmap. Quickly assess the impact of vulnerabilities and identify End-of-Life/End-of-Support hardware/software to create and lead a remediation plan. Discovering, identifying, and inventorying all network assets and asset information (model, version, etc) in your respective area of responsibility. Drive continuous improvement of network visibility and telemetry collection to strengthen detection and response capabilities. Lead the development of baseline operations for the team and implement threat detections, automated alerts to proactively identify potential cyber threats, leveraging SIEM tools such as Splunk. Lead the development of incident response protocols to quickly identify, contain, and resolve network security incidents and threats. Execute root cause analysis for incidents, perform regular security control assessments, and lead strategic security solution implementation in a highly scalable environment. Ensuring that the security controls planned for the Networks are operating effectively by performing audits. Leverage network automation and scripting to make the process efficient. Lead the development and upkeep of network automation systems for ongoing security monitoring and early identification of security incidents. Offer technical guidance and expert feedback on the Vendor Plan of Record (POR), selection of security/monitoring tools, and vendor engagements. Develop essential technical documentation, including playbooks, Confluence pages, Network diagrams, and Method of Procedures (MOPs). Prepare and deliver quarterly presentations to leadership detailing project status and updates. Mentor Team members as well as Organizational partners and act as the overall SME. Building healthy relationships across the Operations, Engineering, and Planning organizations to better understand the current and future landscape of the network. What We’re Looking For... You’ll need to have: Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. Demonstrated leadership skills as a project and/or team lead for cross-functional project teams and vendor management. Expert understanding of Spine, Leaf, SDN, OTNGN, and Hub & Spoke network architectures. Expert-level understanding of routing and switching security, including BGP and IGP security, is mandatory, e.g., BGP hijacking, Route injection, and managing complex ACLs. Hands-on experience with internet-scale data sets such as Netflow, BGP, DNS, and IDS logs. Fluency in security frameworks, particularly the application of CIS Benchmarks (Level 1 & 2 hardening) and mitigating MITRE ATT&CK Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) on network devices, along with a solid understanding of network security fundamentals. Expertise in using Python, API, Ansible, or Terraform-type tools to automate and develop custom security “health checks” on network devices. Ability to assess and understand complex transport and 5G-SA network architectures. Understanding of network security fundamental policies and principles. Experience with utilizing SIEM tools like Splunk for performing analysis. Even better if you have one or more of the following: Network Security certifications such as CISSP or other ISC2 certifications. Routing and Switching certifications like CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent vendor certs. Experience with Splunk performing data analysis, Dashboard creation, alerting, and automation. Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions and SIEM tools. Demonstrated organization and project management skills. Knowledge of technical products and systems development lifecycle within a large global enterprise environment. Effective written, interpersonal, and verbal communication skills. Ability to work with diverse stakeholder,s including highly technical teams, business owners, and executives. Strong leadership and mentoring abilities, with experience guiding and developing teams. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ***This role can be located out of any US based Verizon hub location.*** Where you’ll be working In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. Benefits And Compensation Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $120,500.00 - $231,000.00.

review_candidates.title: VP, Emerging Technologies
review_candidates.description: Where Banking Feels Like Belonging At APGFCU, our values are at the heart of everything we do, empowering us as leaders in the credit union movement. We prioritize purpose and connection in how we serve our members, co-workers and communities - helping to navigate life's little and big moments. Who We Are As a member-owned, not-for-profit credit union, APG Federal Credit Union (APGFCU®) empowers our members with financial products and services to support them at every stage of their financial lives, helping them become money smart and financially independent. We proudly serve people in: Harford County Cecil County Baltimore County Baltimore City We believe banking should feel personal, supportive, and human. That goes for our members and our employees. Here, you’re not just filling a role — you’re making a difference in your community. Our team lifts each other up and our leaders invest in your growth. We celebrate wins, recognize and value contributions, and support each other through challenges. We strive for meaningful connections across our teams, because that’s what belonging is all about. Let’s build something meaningful together. Role Summary Under the direction of the Chief Information Officer (CIO), this position leads the credit union’s enterprise data management, artificial intelligence, software development, and emerging technology programs. The role develops strategy, oversees execution, and delivers scalable, secure, and resilient solutions that enable data-driven decision making, improves member and employee experiences, and directly supports strategic initiatives. This leader partners with business and technology stakeholders to identify opportunities, evaluate emerging technologies, guide make-or-buy decisions, and build high performing teams capable of delivering innovation in a highly regulated environment. The position also serves as a backup to the CIO, VP of IT Operations, and VP of IT Infrastructure for management and administrative responsibilities within the IT department. Key Responsibilities Emerging Technologies (20%) : Develops and executes emerging technology strategy across AI, data management, software development, and automation to deliver scalable business capabilities. Monitors disruptive technologies through research, partnerships, networking, and learning; pilots solutions that modernize processes and support digital transformation initiatives with our Member Experience team. Partners with technology and business leaders to assess opportunities, solve complex challenges, guide make-or-buy decisions, and implement technologies aligned with enterprise architecture. Enterprise Data Management (20%) : Oversee enterprise data solutions, including warehousing, integration, modeling, cloud platforms, analytics, and predictive capabilities for reliable data-driven decisions. Implements data practices using ETL/ELT, catalogs, quality controls, and internal and external integrations into cloud data warehouse or lake solutions. Provides hands-on Microsoft SQL expertise, leading database architecture, design, high availability, resilience, and maintenance optimization. Evaluates and implements analytics and business intelligence platforms, including dashboards, reports, models, and tools such as Power BI, built on trusted data foundations. Establishes data governance, policies, KPIs, quality standards, and security practices aligned with regulations. Implement semantic models to standardize data definitions, business logic, and terminology. Prioritizes data use cases and partners with business leaders to clarify data initiatives, priorities, and delivery targets. Artificial Intelligence (20%) : Defines and executes the AI vision with the CIO and leaders, embedding AI/ML into products, processes, platforms, and interaction points. Develops multi-year strategies for AI governance, data fluency, platform integration, agentic AI adoption, and orchestration across enterprise software. Advances responsible AI through literacy, acceptable use support, policy adherence, best practices, and coordination with IT and Security on controls and oversight. Tracks AI adoption, time-to-insight, outcomes, KPIs, ROI, and milestones for implemented use cases. Maintains expertise in machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, and related systems. Software Development (20%) : Leads enterprise software development, API integrations, automated workflows, and connectors using SDLC best practices in a regulated financial environment. Uses an architecture-first approach to ensure secure, observable, auditable, scalable solutions aligned with best practices and technology investments. Supports CI/CD, DevOps, source code repositories, SAST, DAST, defect remediation, and application security hardening. Manages backlogs and partners with IT, Product, Agile, and project teams to deliver features aligned with initiatives and roadmaps. Strategic Planning & Oversight (10%): Develops, implements, and communicates short and long-term goals and roadmaps for data management, AI, and software development. Measures program success against KPIs, corporate goals, metrics, and outcomes; creates transparency through effective data use. Participates in IT change management and the change advisory board, providing expertise and oversight for planned system changes. Serves on committees, working groups, councils, and other bodies to provide technology thought leadership. Partners on marketing technology vendor and tool selection, implementation, and management, ensuring CRM, automation, analytics, and content systems integrate with enterprise data. Applies information security best practices and supports internal, external, and regulatory audits, including NCUA examinations, as required. Leadership and Development (10%): Leads teams delivering production-grade AI platforms, applications, agents, data pipelines, and enterprise solutions. Builds strong relationships with internal & external partners, and vendors; resolves or escalates issues as needed. Attracts, develops, coaches, and mentors talent; supports succession planning, career paths, staffing, retention, and employee relations. Apply strong project and delivery discipline, partnering with project managers, analysts, Agile leads, and teams to achieve outcomes. Motivates staff toward goals, productivity, accuracy, and efficiency while modeling APGFCU leadership, culture, behaviors, and values. Perform Additional Responsibilities: Take on other duties and special projects as needed to support evolving business and team priorities. Perform other related duties as assigned or associated with the responsibility. Physical Demands: Most of your time will be spent working at a computer, collaborating in meetings, and connecting with colleagues and stakeholders. Occasionally, you may attend events, move between workspaces, travel for business, or help transport materials weighing up to 20 pounds. We’re committed to providing reasonable accommodation to support employees in performing the essential responsibilities of the role. A Typical Day In The Role Lead Day-to-Day Priorities: Manage core responsibilities, organize work, and focus on the activities that drive success. This role leads high-demand technology areas and must manage trade-offs while prioritizing key requests Collaborate with Stakeholders: Partner with team members, leaders, customers, and cross-functional colleagues to share updates, solve problems, and move initiatives forward. Supporting Organizational Goals: Work closely with executive leadership to support the tracking and establishment of KPIs, performance goals, and strategic targets using a foundation of data. Participate in Meetings and Discussions: Lead team meetings, planning sessions, and stakeholder discussions to align goals, priorities, and next steps. Participates in forums where technology thought leadership is required. Monitor Progress and Drive Results: Track key projects, manage deliverables, and ensure commitments are completed on time and of high quality. Ensure accountability for team members in managing work and aim to meet and exceed delivery targets. Create and Review Work Products: Develop, update, and review reports, dashboards, visualizations, presentations, communications, documentation, or other materials that support business objectives. Identify Opportunities for Improvement: Streamline processes, increase efficiency, and enhance team or business outcomes. Continuous improvement is a mantra that the person in this role will embody using automation, APIs, data, AI, and more. Stay Responsive and Adapt to Changing Priorities: Manage emails, messages, and requests while balancing planned work with emerging business needs and opportunities. Qualifications Relevant Experience and Education: Requires 10 years in IT enterprise data management, software development, AI, or IT engineering; 5+ years leading high-performing technology teams; and a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data management, AI, or a related field. Microsoft SQL fluency and comparable database experience are required, along with remote workforce experience. Advanced certifications in AI, data science, engineering, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, SQL Server, or related technologies are preferred. Financial services & hands-on technical experience are highly desired. Problem‑Solving Mindset: You enjoy digging into challenges, finding solutions, and improving how things get done. Comfort with Tools and Technology: You’re familiar with the systems or software this role uses, naturally identify best in breed tools, and you’re confident you can learn them quickly. Ability to Work Independently: You take ownership of your work, manage your time well, and keep things moving without needing constant direction. Adaptability and Flexibility: You’re comfortable navigating change, shifting priorities, and learning as you go. Attention to Detail: You take pride in producing accurate, high‑quality work. Commitment to Growth: You’re curious, open to feedback, and excited to keep developing your skills. What Success Looks Like Delivers Great Work: Consistently produces high-quality, accurate, and timely work that customers, stakeholders, and team members can rely on. Meets and Exceeds Expectations: Successfully achieves goals, milestones, and performance objectives while helping advance broader team and business priorities. Builds Strong Relationships: Develops trusted partnerships with colleagues, leaders, customers, and cross-functional teams to collaborate effectively and achieve shared goals. Takes Ownership: Proactively drives work forward, follows through on commitments, and takes accountability for both successes and challenges. Looks for Better Ways to Work: Regularly identifies opportunities to simplify processes, improve efficiency, and enhance overall experience for customers, employees, or stakeholders. Contributes to Team Success: Supports colleagues, shares knowledge, and fosters a positive, collaborative environment where everyone can do their best work. Makes a Meaningful Impact: Delivers results that contribute to business success, improve outcomes, and create value for the team, customers, and organization. Lives Our Values: Demonstrates the behaviors, mindset, and professionalism that reflect the company’s culture, values, and commitment to excellence. Compensation Information $128,600.00 -$231,400.00 annually Offers are based on experience and education APGFCU offers comprehensive benefits such as medical and dental (shared expense), vision, 401(k), life and disability insurance, flexible spending account, employee assistance program, referral program, educational assistance, holidays, PTO, and sick leave. Equal Opportunity Employer APGFCU is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome and supported. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local law. If an accommodation is needed during the hiring process, please email HR@apgfcu.com . Employment with APGFCU is at-will, meaning that either you or APGFCU may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice. APGFCU participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. You can view the details by clicking here or returning to the careers homepage. APGFCU participa en E-Verify y proporcionará al gobierno federal la información de su Formulario I-9 para confirmar que usted está autorizado para trabajar en los EE.UU.. Puede ver los detalles haciendo clic aquí o regresando a la página de inicio de carreras profesionales.

This is a broad systems engineering position with a strong electronics focus. You will work across spacecraft platforms, high-performance optical payloads, laser communications, onboard processing, and the wider systems required to turn satellite data into operational imagery products. The team owns the complete development lifecycle, including mission and system architecture, requirements, supplier coordination, manufacturing, integration, testing, launch, and initial on-orbit operations. What You’ll Be Doing Own the technical interface between the imaging payload and spacecraft bus. Ensure compatibility and optimize performance across electrical, mechanical, thermal, timing, and data interfaces. Lead and support system-level trade studies covering performance, cost, technical risk, and technology insertion. Model and evaluate payload power, data-volume, timing, and electrical interactions. Develop and maintain electrical Interface Control Documents and other system design documentation. Evaluate emerging technologies, commercial hardware, flight-ready components, and new mission concepts. Assess the system-level integration feasibility of new electronics and payload technologies. Support major technical reviews, including SRR, PDR, and CDR. Work with spacecraft, payload, ground, software, and mission teams to ensure system performance and reliability. Interpret schematics, block diagrams, and PCB layouts to understand the system-level impact of hardware changes. Troubleshoot payload and spacecraft electronics, potentially down to circuit level depending on experience. What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline. At least three years of experience supporting space-based optical remote sensing payloads or comparable complex hardware systems. Experience developing and managing interfaces between spacecraft and payload systems. Strong understanding of electrical interfaces and cross-functional spacecraft integration. Experience developing specifications, requirements, and Interface Control Documents. Ability to interpret electrical schematics, system block diagrams, and PCB layouts. Experience assessing the broader system implications of component-level or circuit-level design changes. Working knowledge of MATLAB and Python, with the ability to quickly learn additional engineering tools. Familiarity with modern electronics technologies, including FPGAs, processors, memory, and data-storage devices. Experience working across payload, spacecraft, software, ground, and operational teams. Strong technical communication and multidisciplinary collaboration skills. Particularly Valuable Experience Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics, or a related field. Electrical systems engineering experience on spacecraft or other space platforms. Radiation-effects analysis, parts derating, component qualification, or radiation-tolerant electronics. Optical imaging payloads, including visible, multispectral, or hyperspectral systems. Understanding of imaging performance metrics such as signal-to-noise ratio and modulation transfer function. STK, SPICE, HFSS, signal-integrity tools, or power-integrity analysis software. Laser communications or high-rate spacecraft data systems. Fault management, redundancy architectures, and reliability engineering for long-duration missions. Familiarity with NASA, JPL, ECSS, MIL-STD-1547, IPC, or comparable space-industry standards. Experience supporting spacecraft manufacturing, integration, environmental testing, launch, or early on-orbit operations. This is an opportunity to work on highly integrated satellite systems where electronics, payload performance, spacecraft design, and mission capability are closely connected. The successful engineer will combine strong systems thinking with practical electronics knowledge and will be comfortable moving between high-level architecture, interface definition, detailed hardware analysis, and hands-on troubleshooting.

new_matches.description: GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide. Technology Group We experiment, design, and lead a 24×7 global business where we support core capabilities in asset management, trading, investment operations, and risk management. We deliver secure, reliable, and integrated solutions, and provide insights on new, and emerging technologies. Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Resilience (ICR) We design, build, and secure the technology foundations that power GIC’s global investment operations. We aim to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure infrastructure that empowers our people and businesses to perform securely, efficiently, and effectively. What impact can you make in this role? The AVP/VP, Network Engineer is responsible for the design, engineering, and delivery of network infrastructure across all GIC data centres and office sites globally. This hands-on technical role owns the architecture and build of Data Centre, Campus, and WAN/SD-WAN networks across a multi-vendor estate, and applies network automation to improve consistency, scalability, and delivery velocity. The role partners closely with Network Operations, Security, and other infrastructure engineering teams to translate business and technical requirements into resilient, secure, and standardised network solutions. This is an individual-contributor technical role. In addition to deep hands-on engineering across Data Centre Networks, Campus Networks (wired and wireless), and SD-WAN, the role engages vendors and product principals to drive feature enhancements and influence product roadmaps, and requires the ability to develop, read and make edits to automation code (Ansible), backed by sound knowledge of financial-sector security and compliance requirements. What will you do as an AVP/VP, Network Automation and Reliability Engineer? Network Engineering & Solution Design Leadership Lead the design and engineering of network solutions across Data Centre, Campus, and WAN/SD-WAN domains, ensuring scalability, resilience, security, and performance. Produce high-quality low-level and high-level designs (HLDs/LLDs), standards, and reference architectures aligned to financial-industry best practices. Act as the technical authority and design-approval reviewer for network changes and new builds, ensuring engineering rigour and adherence to architectural standards. Partner with Network Operations, Security, and other infrastructure engineering teams to translate requirements into deployable, well-documented solutions. Core Engineering Responsibilities Data Centre Networks Design, build, and evolve data centre fabrics using EVPN/VXLAN, Cisco ACI, and modern spine-leaf architectures across a multi-vendor estate (e.g., Cisco, Arista, Juniper). Engineer multi-tenancy, segmentation, and high-availability designs, including integration with load balancers (e.g., F5 LTM/GTM) and L4–L7 services. Define oversubscription, capacity, and failure-domain strategies to support trading and critical workloads. Campus Networks Engineer enterprise campus LAN and wireless solutions (routing, switching, Wi-Fi 6/7 with a managed controller ecosystem) using standardised, templated designs across sites of varying size. Implement access security and segmentation (802.1X, NAC, zoning) in collaboration with Security teams. Ensure resilient, performant designs for corporate connectivity. SD-WAN, WAN & Secure Connectivity Design and deliver SD-WAN and WAN solutions, including overlay transport, application-aware routing, secure connectivity, and cloud on-ramp, using leading platforms (e.g., Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN/Viptela, Fortinet, Versa, VMware VeloCloud, or equivalent). Embed Zero Trust and SASE principles into WAN and remote-access designs (e.g., Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, Prisma Access, or equivalent). Lead WAN modernisation and migration efforts (e.g., MPLS to SD-WAN) with structured, low-risk transition plans. Engineer secure interconnectivity between data centres, campus sites, and cloud providers. Network Automation (Ansible) Develop new, read, interpret, and make edits to existing Ansible playbooks, roles, and Jinja2 templates to support network provisioning, configuration management, and compliance. Maintain and extend standardised configuration templates, and use automated validation within delivery workflows. Apply automation to drive configuration consistency, support drift detection, and reduce manual TOIL across the network estate. (Preferred) Familiarity with adjacent automation/IaC tooling — Python scripting, Terraform, YAML, and CI/CD pipelines (Git-based) — to support scalable, repeatable delivery. Security & Resilience Integration Embed security baselines, hardening standards, and segmentation into all network designs. Engineer for high availability, redundancy, and compliance with internal RTO/RPO and resilience targets. Project Delivery & Lifecycle Management Lead engineering delivery for network projects from design through build, testing, and handover to operations. Develop detailed test plans, simulation/validation approaches, implementation steps, and rollback strategies for high-risk changes. Maintain comprehensive design documentation, build guides, and as-built records to meet operational and audit expectations. Observability, Performance & Troubleshooting Design and apply network observability — telemetry, monitoring, flow analytics, and dashboards — to provide visibility across DC, campus, and WAN. Provide advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex, cross-domain network issues, including performance optimisation. Establish baselines and proactive alerting to detect and pre-empt performance degradation. Vendor & Product Engagement Engage vendors and product principals to evaluate technologies and influence feature enhancements and product roadmaps aligned to the firm’s network strategy. Provide structured technical feedback, raise and track enhancement and defect requests, and validate fixes and new features through proofs-of-concept and testing. Maintain strong working relationships with OEMs and partners to support technical escalations, product lifecycle planning, and assessment of emerging technologies. Collaboration & Standards Work closely with the Network Operations team to ensure solutions are operable, monitored, and supportable, and to incorporate operational feedback into designs. Define and maintain engineering standards, design templates, and gold-standard configuration baselines. Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex network issues and share engineering knowledge across teams. Governance, Risk & Compliance Ensure all network designs and changes adhere to internal controls, security baselines, and regulatory frameworks (MAS-TRM, CSA CCoP, and NIST CISF guidelines). Support internal/external audits with design documentation, technical evidence, and explanations of network controls and configurations. What qualifications or skills should you possess in this role? Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience. Experience: 8–12 years of experience in Network Engineering, with at least 3–5 years in a senior design/engineering capacity—preferably in the financial industry. (AVP candidates: 6–10 years with demonstrated hands-on engineering depth.) Technical Expertise: Data Centre Networks (EVPN/VXLAN, Cisco ACI, spine-leaf, F5 LTM/GTM) across a multi-vendor estate (Cisco, Arista, Juniper) Enterprise Campus Networks (routing, switching, Wi-Fi 6/7 and wireless controller ecosystems) SD-WAN design and delivery on leading platforms (e.g., Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN/Viptela, Fortinet, Versa, VMware VeloCloud) and WAN technologies Zero Trust / SASE and network security (segmentation, NAC, IDS/IPS, firewalls; e.g., Zscaler or Prisma Access or Netskope) Working ability to create, read and edit network automation code, primarily Ansible (playbooks, roles, Jinja2 templates), with version control (Git) (Preferred) Adjacent automation/IaC — Python, Terraform, YAML, CI/CD pipelines Strong knowledge of networking protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IPsec, DNS, DHCP, QoS) Network observability and monitoring tooling (telemetry, flow analytics, dashboards) Cloud Networking (AWS, GCP, Azure) Certifications (preferred): Professional certifications such as CCNP/CCIE (Enterprise or Data Center); relevant security or SD-WAN vendor certifications Familiarity with ITIL, NIST CSF, and financial-sector risk frameworks Comfortable reading and modifying automation scripts (Ansible, Python) to improve consistency and reduce operational risk Soft Skills Strong technical depth with the ability to lead complex network design and delivery end-to-end as an individual contributor. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause-analysis skills, with clear communication for both technical and executive audiences. Ability to engage and influence vendors and product principals to shape enhancements and roadmaps. Collaborative mindset with the ability to influence across architecture, operations, and compliance teams. Work at the Point of Impact We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact. GIC is a Great Place to Work At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise. GIC is an equal opportunity employer As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution. Learn more about our Technology Group here: https://gic.careers/group/technology-group/ Our PRIME Values GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About The Role: The Get Data In (GDI) Integrations Lab team at Next-Gen SIEM builds and maintains world-class lab environments that accelerate security research, detection engineering, and third-party integrations. We provide the reliable, scalable infrastructure and comprehensive product coverage that enable CrowdStrike's data-connector, SOAR-connector, detection-content, threat-research, and Exposure Management teams to design, test, validate, and ship security integrations faster and at scale. Our purpose is to eliminate barriers to integration development through automated provisioning, consistent testing environments, realistic event simulation, and proactive maintenance of a large fleet of third-party security product instances. We host and simulate 70+ live third-party products across a multi-cloud (AWS / Azure / GCP) and on-premises footprint, and we partner closely with CrowdStrike's Technology Ecosystem / Business Development team to procure the licenses that power the lab. We are looking for a passionate Cloud Infrastructure & Security Engineer to design, automate, and operate this environment. This is a hands-on infrastructure role: you will stand up and maintain the networking, cloud accounts, security appliances, and automation that dozens of engineering teams depend on every day. The ideal candidate has deep experience in cloud infrastructure, network security, Infrastructure-as-Code, and administering enterprise security products (firewalls, IDS/IPS, email security, identity, cloud security), and enjoys turning manual toil into self-service automation. What You'll Do: Design, build, and operate the Next-Gen SIEM Lab's multi-cloud infrastructure — AWS hub-and-spoke networking (VPCs, Transit Gateway, NAT/Internet Gateways, subnets, route tables, jumphosts), plus Azure and GCP environments. Deploy, configure, and maintain a large fleet of third-party security products in the lab — firewalls and network security appliances (Palo Alto, Check Point, Fortinet FortiGate, Cisco ASA, F5 BIG-IP), email security (Abnormal, FortiMail, Proofpoint, Mimecast), NDR (Corelight), DDI (Infoblox vNIOS), threat intel (ThreatQ), Active Directory domains, and cloud-native services. Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) — build reusable, per-vendor-product modules so any product can be stood up on demand, managed through GitLab with remote state, locking, and CI/CD pipelines. Build and run the automated event-simulation platform that generates realistic test data for connectors (AWS Lambda + EventBridge, Secret Manager / Thycotic, Docker images in Artifactory, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, CloudWatch, SNS alerting) — expanding coverage across new connectors. Implement and operate automated patch and compliance management (AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager, Fleet Manager, Maintenance Windows, State Manager, Security Hub) to keep the fleet secure and compliant across regions and time zones. new_matches.title: Principal Security Engineer
new_matches.description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. What You’ll Be Doing... The Verizon Network Security team is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Principal Engineer to join the Net-Sec Defense Organization under the Broadband Access team. You will be responsible for owning the Network security posture, Security Lifecycle and protection against threats across the Broadband access network that includes, but is not limited to Edge Routers, Broadband Access routers and switches, CPE equipment and RAN transport infrastructure. The candidate will be required to understand complex network architectures utilizing various protocols, topologies, and vendor hardware . This role involves hands-on work and demonstrating subject matter expertise with Routers, switches, and other networking gear, as well as Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools, particularly Splunk and ISE. The engineer would be required to leverage automation platforms to develop scripts and tools to enhance security operations and play a key role in monitoring, analyzing, and leading response to network security incidents while implementing proactive measures to safeguard critical assets. You will be responsible for continuously monitoring and proactively detecting threats to safeguard network functions and assets, with a focus on leveraging automation and AI. This includes accountability for the network security scorecard for each network element type. Additionally, you will collaborate with internal organizations and vendors to improve security posture by implementing Network Security Policies across diverse network elements. Planning, designing, and leading execution of Network Security policies across all owned assets. Utilize existing expertise of routing, switching and network architecture to build a deep understanding of the network assets under your span of control and the product and feature roadmap. Quickly assess the impact of vulnerabilities and identify End-of-Life/End-of-Support hardware/software to create and lead a remediation plan. Discovering, identifying, and inventorying all network assets and asset information (model, version, etc) in your respective area of responsibility. Drive continuous improvement of network visibility and telemetry collection to strengthen detection and response capabilities. Lead the development of baseline operations for the team and implement threat detections, automated alerts to proactively identify potential cyber threats, leveraging SIEM tools such as Splunk. Lead the development of incident response protocols to quickly identify, contain, and resolve network security incidents and threats. Execute root cause analysis for incidents, perform regular security control assessments, and lead strategic security solution implementation in a highly scalable environment. Ensuring that the security controls planned for the Networks are operating effectively by performing audits. Leverage network automation and scripting to make the process efficient. Lead the development and upkeep of network automation systems for ongoing security monitoring and early identification of security incidents. Offer technical guidance and expert feedback on the Vendor Plan of Record (POR), selection of security/monitoring tools, and vendor engagements. Develop essential technical documentation, including playbooks, Confluence pages, Network diagrams, and Method of Procedures (MOPs). Prepare and deliver quarterly presentations to leadership detailing project status and updates. Mentor Team members as well as Organizational partners and act as the overall SME. Building healthy relationships across the Operations, Engineering, and Planning organizations to better understand the current and future landscape of the network. What We’re Looking For... You’ll need to have: Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. Demonstrated leadership skills as a project and/or team lead for cross-functional project teams and vendor management. Expert understanding of Spine, Leaf, SDN, OTNGN, and Hub & Spoke network architectures. Expert-level understanding of routing and switching security, including BGP and IGP security, is mandatory, e.g., BGP hijacking, Route injection, and managing complex ACLs. Hands-on experience with internet-scale data sets such as Netflow, BGP, DNS, and IDS logs. Fluency in security frameworks, particularly the application of CIS Benchmarks (Level 1 & 2 hardening) and mitigating MITRE ATT&CK Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) on network devices, along with a solid understanding of network security fundamentals. Expertise in using Python, API, Ansible, or Terraform-type tools to automate and develop custom security “health checks” on network devices. Ability to assess and understand complex transport and 5G-SA network architectures. Understanding of network security fundamental policies and principles. Experience with utilizing SIEM tools like Splunk for performing analysis. Even better if you have one or more of the following: Network Security certifications such as CISSP or other ISC2 certifications. Routing and Switching certifications like CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent vendor certs. Experience with Splunk performing data analysis, Dashboard creation, alerting, and automation. Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions and SIEM tools. Demonstrated organization and project management skills. Knowledge of technical products and systems development lifecycle within a large global enterprise environment. Effective written, interpersonal, and verbal communication skills. Ability to work with diverse stakeholder,s including highly technical teams, business owners, and executives. Strong leadership and mentoring abilities, with experience guiding and developing teams. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ***This role can be located out of any US based Verizon hub location.*** Where you’ll be working In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. Benefits And Compensation Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $120,500.00 - $231,000.00.

About The Team The Staff Consulting Architect will be a vital member of Nutanix's Professional Services team, which is dedicated to delivering innovative virtualization, software-defined networking (SDN), and network security solutions to our clients. This team operates from Bangalore or Pune and fosters a collaborative and inclusive culture that values creativity and knowledge sharing. The mission of the team is to empower organizations with next-generation data center and hybrid cloud environments that enhance performance, security, and scalability. You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who promotes a supportive and mentoring leadership style, focusing on empowering team members to achieve their full potential and encouraging a strong sense of collaboration. The role is hybrid, requiring the employee to come into the office three days a week, fostering teamwork and facilitating knowledge exchange while allowing flexibility for remote work. Nutanix is seeking a Staff Consulting Architect specializing in virtualization, software-defined networking (SDN), and network security to design, implement, and optimize next-generation data centre and hybrid cloud environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong hands-on expertise in hypervisors (VMware / AHV) and a deep understanding of network virtualization and microsegmentation concepts. While certain specialized or automation-related areas can be developed through internal enablement programs, strong fundamentals in virtualization and SDN are mandatory. Your Role Architecture & Design Lead the design and deployment of SDN solutions including: Virtual networks, overlays (Geneve / VXLAN), logical switches and routers. Network Controllers / Managers for centralized control and automation. VPCs or logical segments for tenant isolation and scalability. Gateways, VPNs, and BGP configurations for hybrid connectivity. Architect multi-tier microsegmentation strategies and enforce Zero Trust principles. Collaborate with enterprise network and security teams for seamless integration between virtual and physical infrastructures. Implement application-centric security and isolation policies for East-West and North-South traffic control. Support workload and network migrations between virtualization platforms with minimal downtime. Integrate network visibility and flow analytics into compliance systems. Security & Policy Management Define and enforce microsegmentation and application security frameworks. Manage security groups, categories, or tags for dynamic policy application. Configure allowlist / denylist rules and quarantine mechanisms. Ensure compliance with enterprise standards; integrate with SIEM / Syslog for auditability. Platform & Virtualization Management Manage and optimize virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere / Nutanix AHV / equivalent). Administer orchestration and lifecycle management using Prism Central, vCenter, or similar tools. Support hybrid cloud network architectures spanning on-premises and public cloud environments. Collaborate with compute and storage teams to ensure end-to-end performance. Troubleshooting & Optimization Diagnose and resolve issues related to network overlays, routing, and policy enforcement. Utilize CLI tools, REST APIs, or automation scripts for diagnostics and configuration management. Perform performance tuning and maintain high availability of network services. Strong understanding of networking concepts — VLANs, routing, NAT, VPNs, BGP, firewalls, overlays (VXLAN/Geneve). Strong troubleshooting skills using CLI / API / network analysis tools. Excellent consulting, customer engagement, and communication skills. Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform or Ansible. Exposure to hybrid or multi-cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP). Dan is dit een mooie uitdaging voor jou. Dit ga je doen Beheren en onderhouden van IT-omgevingen bij verschillende klanten; Uitvoeren van werkplekbeheer en ondersteunen van eindgebruikers; Beheren van Windows Server-omgevingen, Active Directory en Microsoft 365; Configureren en beheren van netwerken, switches, firewalls, VLAN's en WLAN-omgevingen; Beheren van internetverbindingen en telefonieoplossingen; Uitvoeren van periodiek onderhoud en preventieve controles; Signaleren van verbeterkansen en adviseren van klanten over hun IT-infrastructuur; Oplossen van complexe storingen en technische vraagstukken; Samenwerken met collega's om klanten een stabiele, veilige en toekomstbestendige IT-omgeving te bieden. Hier ga je werken Je gaat aan de slag bij een regionale IT-dienstverlener die organisaties ondersteunt met het beheer, onderhoud en de verdere ontwikkeling van hun IT-omgeving. De organisatie richt zich voornamelijk op het mkb en staat bekend om haar persoonlijke benadering, korte lijnen en langdurige klantrelaties. Omdat veel klanten geen eigen IT-afdeling hebben, krijg je een brede en verantwoordelijke rol. Je bent niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor het oplossen van technische vraagstukken, maar denkt ook actief mee over verbeteringen en toekomstige ontwikkelingen binnen de IT-omgeving van de klant. Hierdoor combineer je techniek met advies en bouw je een sterke relatie op met de organisaties die je ondersteunt. Je werkt grotendeels bij klanten op locatie, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is. Gemiddeld bezoek je meerdere klanten per week en krijg je te maken met uiteenlopende infrastructuren en technische vraagstukken. Daarnaast werk je één vaste dag per week samen met je collega's op kantoor om kennis te delen, projecten af te stemmen en de samenwerking binnen het team te versterken. Binnen de organisatie heerst een informele en betrokken werksfeer waarin samenwerking, persoonlijke aandacht en ontwikkeling centraal staan.
